narrative.overview:
The marketing site is an open graphite filing-cabinet drawer: hanging manila tabs for navigation, stacked kraft-spined folders for sections, and a rubber-stamp teal CTA. It reads as household record-keeping on this machine — sites as labeled folders — not a cloud backup dashboard of equal feature cards.

Depth comes from metal drawer chrome, hard folder borders, stacked manila layers, and a slightly skewed stamp. Typography pairs Archivo (tabs, brand, stamps, labels) with Source Sans 3 (body). Soft full-page gradient washes, icon-card grids, and system display faces are out of world.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed graphite metal drawer; manila folder faces with kraft spine and tab
Hanging uppercase tabs as primary nav; brand is a kraft tab and hero display name
Rubber-stamp primary CTA (solid teal, hard border, slight rotate); dashed ghost secondary
Trust as typed cross-check labels and ruled lists — not metric cards
Archivo + Source Sans 3; hard metal-deep borders throughout

rules.name: The Stamp Is the Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal appears on CTAs (and ghost-stamp text). Kraft marks tabs, spines, and structural labels — do not swap their jobs or flood the page with either.

rules.name: The Manila Ground Rule
rules.body: Content lives on manila folder faces inside the metal drawer. Cream is for the command sheet inset, not a second full-page background.

rules.name: The No Soft Wash Rule
rules.body: Cabinet depth is a hard metal gradient and stacked folders. Do not add decorative soft color washes behind sections.

rules.name: The Brand Speaks First Rule
rules.body: In the hero, BackupBinder is display-scale; the headline must not overpower it. No kicker or eyebrow above the brand or headline.

rules.name: The Typed Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase Archivo labels are for chrome (tabs, stamps, cross-check keys, flow steps). Body sentences stay sentence case in Source Sans 3.

rules.name: The Hard Edge Rule
rules.body: Folders, tabs, stamps, and the cream sheet use 2–3px metal-deep borders. Do not substitute soft shadow-only cards for that stroke language.

rules.name: The Stamp Offset Rule
rules.body: Hard offset shadows belong on the rubber stamp (and folder stack geometry), not as a generic card costume across the page.

rules.name: The Open Tab Rule
rules.body: Hanging tabs and peeks never close their bottom edge — they hang from the metal rail or the folder face.

dos: Do keep the first viewport as one open folder: brand, one headline, one lede, stamp CTA group, cross-check, and next-folder peek.
Do use hanging tabs for in-page nav and kraft for the active/brand tab.
Do express sequences as ruled flow/doors/trust lists, not icon+heading card grids.
Do reserve stamp teal for CTAs and kraft for structural cabinet cues.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion (instant hero in; no scroll hijacking).
donts: Don't rebuild this as the localhost Household Binder Operate UI (system UI sans, paper pane, left rail) — that system lives in the repo-root DESIGN.md.
Don't add kickers/eyebrows above brand or headlines.
Don't introduce soft purple/indigo washes, glass blurs, or metric/stat strips in the hero.
Don't use emoji or glyph icons for trust markers; keep the square ok markers or typed labels.
Don't invent testimonials, customers, or benchmarks; WordPress stays one addon, not the product story.
